title: Mixed numbers
examples: How do I change a mixed number to an improper fraction?
Can I add two mixed numbers together?
What do I do when I multiply mixed numbers?

explain.say: Today we learn about mixed numbers and improper fractions. These are just two ways to write the same amount. We will learn how to change between them easily.
An improper fraction has a top number bigger than the bottom number. A mixed number has a whole number and a fraction. They mean the same thing.
To change an improper fraction to a mixed number, you divide the top by the bottom. The answer is the whole number part. The remainder is the new top number.

draw.text: Divide top by bottom; remainder is new top.

explain.say: Let us try an example. We change nine divided by four. Nine divided by four is two with a remainder of one. So it is two and one fourth.
When adding, first change any mixed numbers to improper fractions. Then you can add the numerators and keep the same denominator. Remember to simplify your answer.

faq.q: How do I change a mixed number to an improper fraction?
faq.a: You multiply the whole number by the bottom number, then add the top number. Finally, you keep the same bottom number. You can also ask how to convert a mixed number to an improper fraction.
asks: What is the improper fraction for $3 rac{1}{4}$?
How do I turn this mixed number into a fraction?

faq.q: Do I need to change everything to improper fractions before multiplying?
faq.a: Yes, it is easiest to change all mixed numbers to improper fractions first. Then you multiply the top numbers together and the bottom numbers together. You can also ask what to do when multiplying mixed numbers.
asks: Should I multiply $2 rac{1}{2}$ by $3 rac{1}{3}$?
What is the first step for mixed number multiplication?

faq.q: When adding, do I just add the whole numbers and the fractions separately?
faq.a: You must combine the whole numbers and the fractions carefully. If the fractions add up to one or more, you carry over that extra amount. You might also ask how to add mixed numbers.
asks: Is it okay to add $1 rac{2}{3}$ and $2 rac{2}{3}$?
What happens if the fractions add up to more than one?

faq.q: Can I add mixed numbers without changing them first?
faq.a: You can, but it is easier to change them first. You add the whole numbers and add the fractions separately. Then you combine any extra whole numbers you get. You might also ask about adding mixed numbers.
asks: What is the simplest way to add $3 rac{1}{5}$ and $1 rac{2}{5}$?
Should I add the whole numbers first or the fractions?

faq.q: What is the difference between an improper and mixed number?
faq.a: A mixed number has a whole number part and a proper fraction part. An improper fraction has a top number that is equal to or larger than the bottom number. You can also ask what these terms mean.
asks: Is $5/4$ an improper or mixed number?
Does $1 rac{1}{2}$ count as a mixed number?

facts: An improper fraction has a numerator greater than or equal to its denominator.
A mixed number consists of a whole number and a proper fraction.
To convert improper to mixed, divide the top by the bottom.
When adding, convert to improper fractions first for simplicity.

quiz.say: What is the mixed number form of twelve divided by five?
quiz.why: Twelve divided by five is two with a remainder of two, so the answer is two and two fifths.

wrong.0: This is wrong because the remainder is two, not one.
wrong.2: This is the improper fraction form, not the mixed number.
wrong.3: This is incorrect because you must use the whole number part from the division.

quiz.say: What is the result of $2 rac{1}{3} + 1 rac{1}{3}$?
quiz.why: Add the whole numbers and add the fractions separately, then combine them.

wrong.0: This mistake happens if you only add the whole numbers once.
wrong.1: This is incorrect because you must add the whole numbers as well.
wrong.2: This is wrong because you forgot to add the whole numbers together.

quiz.why: Convert both to improper fractions and multiply the numerators and denominators.

wrong.1: This is wrong because you added the whole numbers instead of multiplying.
wrong.2: This is incorrect because you only multiplied the whole numbers.
wrong.3: This mistake happens if you only multiply the fractional parts.
